text:
release-manager: FYI: deploybot blocked payment-service canary during tonight's change window. We saw a cross-registry digest drift between ECR and GCR mirrors. Need quick decision whether to pin, re-publish, or roll back.

deploybot: HALT: DIGEST_REPLICATE_ANOMALY. Release manifest expected sha256:ffee1122, ecr-us-west reports sha256:ffee1122, gcr-eu reports sha256:ccdd3344. Code: ERR_DIGEST_REPLICA_MISMATCH

ci-bot: Build 2024-09-15T02:10:00Z. Created multi-arch manifest and attempted cosign. Signing job retried once at 02:10:45 due to transient KMS error. The final cosign annotation exists in primary registry but mirror may have missed the annotation.

marie: @release-manager I recommend pinning to last-good digest to avoid partially-applied DB schema changes. We can reopen deployment after infra verifies replica annotations.

derek: Ops note: If we republish, there's risk of creating a new digest and invalidating the release-id that downstream telemetry expects. Pinning keeps release-id stable.

sasha: Filing infra ticket REG-3522 either way. We need to check replication logs and cosign annotations across regions. If mirror returns an orphan manifest, we might need a mirror-resync instead of republish.

clare: From product: prefer pin+hold. Add release note: "Canary held; investigating registry replication difference. No user-facing impact."

tom-oncall: I'll do the pin and watch the rollout. Command pattern from deploybot below.

deploybot: Recommended pin command:
```
kubectl set image deploy/payment-service payment-service=123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/payment-service@sha256:ffee1122 --namespace=prod
/deploy promote payment-service --from-manual
```
Note: deploybot will still block if the attestation annotations for the pinned digest don't match the release manifest.

marie: Decision: pin to sha256:ffee1122 (v3.4.0). Hold v3.4.2. Infra investigation to follow.

release-manager: Action items: @tom-oncall pin+promote, @clare write release blurb, @sasha file REG-3522, @derek validate telemetry after pin. I'll update the release board.

tom-oncall: Pin started, monitoring logs.

deploybot: Promotion success: payment-service pinned to sha256:ffee1122. Rollout event at 1715161148.

tom-oncall: Rollout stable after 6m. No errors. Holding release.

clare: Posted release note to notes doc.

sasha: REG-3522 filed and assigned to registry-team. Included cosign snapshots and replicate timestamps.

release-manager: Thanks. Will reopen once REG-3522 has findings. Closing thread for this window.
